detail.longDescription: Your coding agent can run a repo's code before you approve anything. Agents call git status in the background, and git runs whatever core.fsmonitor names in the repo's .git/config. Manifold Security hit 7 agents. Cloning is safe; a shared zip holding .git is not. Qwen Code, Grok Build, Hermes Agent: unpatched as of Sept 1. https://www. manifold.security/blog/ai-codi ng-agents-git-hijack Agent terminals in a browser tab: https:// shell.online # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # Git
